description: Scaffold a new Laravel application with `composer create-project laravel/laravel` (latest stable skeleton, resolved live from Packagist), or bring an existing Laravel app up to this catalog's toolchain, then post-process it: `config/app.php` `'version' => env('APP_VERSION', '0.1.0-dev')` (the `x.y.z-dev` convention `iru-php-bump-version` maintains), `config.platform.php` pinned to the PHP floor, Pest (default; arch tests with the php/security/laravel presets) or PHPUnit, `phpunit.xml` fast suites (Unit + Feature on SQLite `:memory:`), Pint (`pint.json`), Larastan (`phpstan.neon`, level 9 for a new app, level 6 plus a generated baseline for an existing one), composer scripts (`test`, `test:coverage` with Clover/JUnit under `build/logs/` and an 80% floor, `lint`, `lint:report`, `format`, `format:check`), a sample action + Form Request + policy + resource with feature tests, and — each only when chosen — a DB-backed `Integration` suite (`phpunit.integration.xml`, MySQL or PostgreSQL), Laravel Sail, a production `Dockerfile` (FrankenPHP or PHP-FPM + Nginx) for `distribution: internal`, `sonar-project.properties`, and Laravel Boost as a dev-only dependency — plus browser UI tests per the catalog's UI contract: `.ui-quality.yml`, Playwright (`playwright.config.ts` serving `php artisan serve`) with `@axe-core/playwright`, the shared `tests/e2e/support/ui-screenshots.ts` helper, and a `WelcomePage` spec capturing `.ui-screenshots/screen/WelcomePage/` across left-to-right/right-to-left × light/dark with an accessibility check. Invoke as `/iru-setup-php-laravel`. Accepts pre-resolved inputs via `args` (`key: value` lines) — `name`, `slug`, `vendor`, `description`, `license`, `developer-name`, `developer-email`, `organization-url`, `php-version`, `open-source`, `visibility`, `ci`, `ci-tests` (`unit`/`full`), `distribution` (`none`/`internal`), `sonar` (+ `sonar-organization`/ `sonar-project-key`/`sonar-host-url`), `accessibility` (`enforce`/`report`/`off`), `test-framework` (`pest`/`phpunit`), `integration-tests` (`none`/`mysql`/`pgsql`), `sail`, `boost` (`yes`/`no`), `runtime` (`frankenphp`/`fpm`), `mode` (`new`/`existing`), `on-existing` (`ask`/`keep`/`update`/`replace`) — so `iru-setup-php-repository` can drive it without re-prompting; stand-alone it asks whatever `args` didn't resolve. Announces whether it is scaffolding from scratch or updating an existing app and, for every artifact it owns that already exists, warns and asks Update / Keep as is / Replace (or Stop). Ends by running the same commands as the `iru-php-test`, `iru-php-coverage`, and `iru-php-code-quality` gates. Use whenever a repository needs a Laravel application bootstrapped with its full test/coverage/static-analysis/style toolchain from this house template, instead of running `laravel new` and wiring the rest by hand.
